phaseAssessment.headline: Aerobic engine objective largely complete. Threshold phase begins now.
phaseAssessment.body: 13 weeks of structured training produced the core adaptation: cardiac drift moved from +8.4 bpm baseline to multiple negative readings by W8. LT1 confirmed at 9.5 km/h — above initial estimate of 8.5 km/h. GCT improved from 361ms to 302ms program best. 17.15km outdoor long run in 30°C heat with controlled HR and correct fueling. Zero significant injuries throughout. The quality work in W11–W14 was dosed below threshold — the 150 bpm ceiling, set from an unvalidated max HR estimate, suppressed Quality A and B paces below LT1. Corrected Aug 11. Max HR revised from 168 to 178–188 bpm estimate.
phaseAssessment.nextObjective: Build LT2 from estimated 10.2–10.8 km/h toward ≥12.0 km/h — the explicit gate for sub-4 viability. September lactate test is the first hard measurement. Quality A at 9.8–10.3 km/h and Quality B at 9.0–9.2 km/h from W15.

phaseAssessment.headline: 10K time trial complete. 61:17. LCRS baseline: 7.6 min. Threshold phase begins W15.
phaseAssessment.body: First outdoor 10K time trial delivered the single most important new metric: LCRS (longest continuous run segment) = 7.6 minutes at 5:16/km. This is the constraint that W15–23 quality progression is designed to extend. Running-segment pace 5:20/km confirms capable mechanics at threshold. Walk ratio 17.6% was forced physiology, not failure of will — pace above estimated LT2 for first outdoor sustained effort. GCT 284ms is a new program best. Max HR 164 new observed floor, reserve confirmed at finish (avg 148, max 155 in final 5 min against 164 ceiling). Zero tissue complaint across 10 km with 19 acceleration cycles is the highest confidence tissue data in the program. W14 closed: 26.06 km.
phaseAssessment.nextObjective: LCRS 7.6 min → 20 min continuous at LT2 by W20. W15: 4×6 min @ 9.8–10.0 km/h (Quality A). Every quality session extends the longest unbroken block. Regenetics Sep 2026 is the next hard measurement.

phaseAssessment.headline: W15 closed. 35.88 km. Negative cardiac drift. LCRS 51.3 min easy record. Ceiling raised to 160.
phaseAssessment.body:
W15 delivered across every dimension. Long run R67 — the headline metric — produced cardiac drift of −4.8 bpm: HR went down over 96 minutes in 30°C heat at week-end. That is the aerobic base working. LCRS 51.3 min at easy pace is the longest continuous run in the program. Quality B established at 9.0 km/h (first session, LCRS 14 min sub-LT1). Quality A continued at 9.8–10.0 km/h, ceiling clean (154 max, Z5 0:00).

Medical: blood results Aug 13 reviewed by Dr. Thắng (Aug 20 phone). All clean. HR ceiling raised 155→160 bpm. Creatine approved pending timing.

Hip protocol initiated. Right ankle-hip chain hypothesis logged: right hip flexor eccentric weakness → variable late-swing → dorsiflexion stress at anterior-lateral right ankle on cold start. Hip protocol is the 8-week natural experiment. Warm-up protocol continues — three consecutive clean runs confirm it resolves the acute presentation.

Gel timing gap identified (R67 depletion spike at km 6.45 from delayed first gel). Rule hardened: first gel at 45 min regardless of perceived energy level.

Gym: all 4 days complete. Full Body Aug 23 — KB raises baseline 3×15 @ 12.5 kg. Pull-ups and L-sit baseline not established this session — carry to W16 Full Body.
phaseAssessment.nextObjective: W16: QB 30 min continuous @ 9.0 km/h (ceiling 160 bpm, no water break). QA 4×8 min @ 9.8–10.0 km/h. LR 16–18 km (gel at 45 min, timer on). Pull-ups 10-8-8 threshold — Priority A W16 Full Body. L-sit baseline to establish. Regenetics VO₂max test Sep/Oct 2026 — book now.

phaseAssessment.headline: W16 closed. 38.17 km. Gate 3 ✅ Gate 4 ✅. Distance PR 20.07 km. QB LCRS 30 min doubled. Fueling rule hardened to 40 min.
phaseAssessment.body:
W16 was the program's structural proof-of-concept week. Two gates cleared simultaneously on Aug 29 (R71): Gate 3 — 20.07 km long run inside a full-load week containing both QA and QB — and Gate 4 — 8 consecutive rising-load weeks injury-free (W9–W16).

R71 is the best aerobic long run in the program: 20.07 km, avg HR 123 bpm, 59% Z2, Z4+Z5 = 0%, max HR 142 bpm over 3h06. An aerobic floor that stable at week-peak load is the base strategy working.

Quality B produced the program's most decisive single-session LCRS jump: 14 min (R66, W15) → 30 min continuous (R70, W16). Doubled in one session at 9.0 km/h. RPE 4/10. Max HR 156 bpm against a 160 ceiling. Headroom confirmed.

Quality A continued 4×8 min format (R69) at 9.8–10.0 km/h, ceiling clean at 154 bpm. QA graduation moves to 2/3.

Fueling rule hardened Aug 29: first gel at 40 min for runs ≥90 min (revised from 45 min). 4 gels minimum for ≥18 km. 60g+/hr carb target. This replaces all prior gel timing rules.

Strength: Trap Bar DL reset protocol closed at 120 kg (1.58× bodyweight) — clean RPE ~7, zero lower-back soreness, working weight re-established. L-sit baseline established — 3×(5×5s). V Squat reached 90 kg plates (+18 kg from 72 kg). Gym 5/5 including a bonus Legs Day Aug 29 pre-vacation.

Connective tissue: zero complaints across 8 consecutive weeks.
phaseAssessment.nextObjective: W17: QA graduation (3/3) — 4×8 min @ 10.0/10.0/10.3/10.3 km/h, ceiling 160 bpm, full walk recovery. QB ceiling test — 9.5 km/h × 25 min then keep running until 160 bpm forces stop (live LCRS extension). LR 18–20 km, 4 gels minimum, 60g+/hr. Regenetics VO₂max test Sep/Oct 2026 — book now. TI-RADS 4 endocrinologist referral still outstanding.
